Settings.PreferGpuAcceleration.zh: 优先使用 GPU 加速

Settings.GpuAccelerationHint.zh: 优先使用 GPU 处理滤镜，保存后生效。
Settings.GpuAccelerationHint.en: Prefer GPU acceleration for filters. Applies on save.

Settings.RenderReasonPending.zh: 等待下一次画布绘制；查看此状态不会触发绘制。
Settings.RenderReasonPending.en: Waiting for the next canvas draw. Viewing this status does not trigger rendering.

Settings.RenderReasonGpu.zh: 该帧整幅画布由 GPU 绘制，包含滤镜和其他标注。
Settings.RenderReasonGpu.en: The GPU rendered that entire canvas frame, including filters and other annotations.

Settings.RenderReasonDisabled.zh: GPU 优先已关闭，使用 CPU 绘制。
Settings.RenderReasonDisabled.en: GPU preference is off; the CPU renders the canvas.

Settings.RenderReasonLight.zh: 轻量场景使用 CPU 缓存，避免额外的 GPU 读回开销。
Settings.RenderReasonLight.en: This light scene uses CPU caching to avoid extra GPU readback overhead.

Settings.RenderReasonFallback.zh: GPU 初始化或绘制失败，已回退 CPU。详情见 diagnostics.log。
Settings.RenderReasonFallback.en: GPU initialization or rendering failed; the CPU fallback is active. See diagnostics.log for details.

Settings.RenderTiming.zh: 最近绘制 {0:0.0} ms · 本次运行 GPU {1} 帧 / CPU {2} 帧
Settings.RenderTiming.en: Last draw {0:0.0} ms · This run: GPU {1} frames / CPU {2} frames
